decision_rule: SECONDARY, no test of its own: delivered-pass counts per arm are reported with their exact one-sided Fisher p and the statement that n = 12 against a Baseline rate near 0.67 is underpowered; it cannot win or lose the claim. Pre-registered sensitivity reading, both arms: the same count after stripping from each patch every path the grader itself names in a 'patch touches non-source path' refusal, repeated until the grader accepts or names none, then graded unchanged. Secondaries reported whatever the outcome, per arm, never pooled across tasks or arms: output tokens and turns to the candidate; the harvested line verdict at 32,000 tokens / 48 turns with its exclusion column; turns from steer to stop. A cell replaced for infrastructure is reported beside its replacement.
